rules.name: Blood sugar or diabetes wording
rules.citation: Amazon Seller Central policy on diabetes-related products (products marketed as diabetes, glucose or sugar treatments need FDA approval), as quoted in Seller Central forums; third-party compliance guides report automated review treats "blood sugar" as a high-sensitivity term. Verify in Seller Central.
rules.explanation: Amazon's automated review flags blood-sugar, glucose and diabetes wording on food and supplement listings, even when the FDA would accept it as a structure/function claim. Listings can be blocked with only a vague reason.
rules.advice: For Amazon, remove this sentence from the pack and listing, or keep qualified wording ("…blood sugar levels already within a normal range") and have documentation ready for an appeal.
